items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Toby, Otto Hardwick, he and I became very good friends.

ctx.x: This was at the Casa Manana. In fact I have a picture of that. A picture of me sitting in the Ellington section with Johnny Hodges on one side and Harry Carney on the other and the other guys. The Ellington Band and my band -- Joe Zuka, who had the Casa Manana, I was sort of the house band in there, you know, and he said, 'I've got Duke Ellington coming in,' he said, 'I'm going to have you both here for the weekend.' I said, 'Oh, great, wonderful.' So now we're plotting backstage, we're going to have to subdue…
